description: Naming: sub-folders and file name stems. The outputSubfolders and outputStem cases are the desktop library (gui/shared/library.ts); the spaceSubfolder and spaceStem cases are the Android library (SpaceLogic) and are limited to Android: the two differ in details (NAMING-1 in DECISIONS.md). isoDate is shared. Time is always an input.
